Question 14
?

Using the cross product curvature formula, find the curvature of r(t)=⟨tcos⁡t,tsin⁡t⟩ as a function of t.

a
t2+2t2+1
b
2t2t2+1
c
t2+2t2+1
d
t2+2(t2+1)3/2
e
t(t2+1)3/2
